values.value: Amplience Frontend Starter ships a content model of 24 content types — seven renderable blocks, plus the smaller repeatable types that make up pages, navigation and site chrome. Every item carries its schema URI in `_meta.schema` and the recursive renderer dispatches on it, so this page is also the map from a content type to the component that draws it.
